Messages.Author: Smiling Tom
Messages.Body:
Can't you smell that smell
Oooooh that smell
the smell of death surrounds you
Lynyrd Skynyrd , "the smell"

What a wonderful surprise. Not the fact that they've used a Lynyrd Skynyrd
lyrics, but the fact that they have used a rock song lyrics again.

If my memory doesn't fails me, there hasn't been this kind of flavour text
since the original set. Let's see if more like this com with KMW set. Can't
wait for the sunday pre-release !!!!!!!
